title: Automated evaluation can distinguish the good and bad AI responses to patient questions about hospitalization.
summary: Automated metrics ranked responses from 28 AI systems to 100 patient hospitalization cases and were compared with clinician-authored references and human ratings; this measures evaluation agreement, not patient outcomes.
ai_technology: Automated evaluation metrics scored outputs from AI systems against clinician-authored references and human annotations.

evidence.tested: The 100-case, 28-system evaluation measures agreement with raters; it does not test patient health outcomes.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed source does not establish prospective benefit, broad external validity, or replication beyond the reported study.
evidence.ai_role: Automated evaluation metrics scored outputs from AI systems against clinician-authored references and human annotations.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
